notes.key_messages:
The space provided and the number of marks available indicates the length and type of response required.
Where extra space is required candidates should ensure that they have noted in the question where on the
script they have written the continuation of their response. It is important that all of the instructions in a
question are followed.
Candidates should know the difference between command words, e.g. state, describe, explain, calculate and
suggest so that they can respond to the question appropriately.
notes.general_comments:
Most candidates were well-prepared for the exam. A good knowledge and understanding of many areas of
the syllabus was shown.
